zh: 她的演示说服了董事会。

en: I need to {work on|improve|practise|practice} my pronunciation.

zh: 演出到一半，一半观众都离场了。
en: Half the audience {walked out|left} halfway through the show.

zh: 飞机的噪音把演讲者的声音都盖过了。
en: The noise of the planes {drowned out} the speaker.

zh: 她很擅长把复杂的想法讲清楚。
en: She's really good at {putting across|getting across|explaining|communicating|conveying} complex ideas.

zh: 我先简单介绍一下我自己。
en: I'll {start off|begin|start|kick off} by introducing myself.

zh: 演讲者只是简单提了一下气候变化。
en: The speaker only briefly {touched on|mentioned} climate change.

zh: 我们已经为这次活动请好了三位演讲者。
en: We've {lined up|booked|organised|organized|arranged|got} three speakers for the event.

zh: 她在演讲时强忍住了泪水。
en: She {fought back|held back|choked back} tears during her speech.

zh: 大家安静一下，我们马上开始。
en: {Settle down|Quieten down|Quiet down|Calm down}, everyone. We're about to start.

zh: 主持人念出了获奖者的名字。
en: The host {read out|called out|announced} the winners' names.

zh: 我把今天的演讲完全搞砸了。
en: I totally {messed up|stuffed up|screwed up|botched} my presentation today.

zh: 把技术概念讲清楚给客户听很难。
en: It's hard to {get across|put across|explain|communicate|convey} technical ideas to clients.

zh: 最后，我来总结一下要点。
en: To finish, let me {sum up|summarise|summarize|recap} the main points.

zh: 轮到你的时候，请站起来自我介绍一下。
en: When it's your turn, please {stand up|get up} and introduce yourself.

zh: 主讲人病了，所以莎拉临时顶上了。
en: The main speaker was sick, so Sarah {stepped in|filled in|stood in}.

zh: 我们把开场白再排练一遍吧。
en: Let's {run through|go over|rehearse|practise|practice} the opening one more time.
